create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue instance to track smoothed metrics over a sliding window with median and global average
update_SmoothedMetrics: update a SmoothedMetrics object with new metric values and get back all smoothed metric strings
get_MetricLogger: get a MetricLogger from a config object to manage training and evaluation logging with TensorBoard support
end_epoch_MetricLogger: call end_epoch on a MetricLogger to log epoch results, save best model, and write TensorBoard scalars
convert_conf_to_tensorboard_table: convert an OmegaConf DictConfig into a formatted markdown table string for TensorBoard HParams logging
